description: This Python source file initializes and provides classes for object detection within the ImageAI library, specifically handling image and video detection using models like RetinaNet, YOLOv3, and TinyYOLOv3. It defines the ObjectDetection and VideoObjectDetection classes, including methods for setting model types, loading models, and detecting objects in images and videos, along with support for custom object detection configurations.

classes.name: ObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on images using different models such as RetinaNet, YOLOv3, and TinyYOLOv3, with methods for setting model types, loading models, detecting objects, and customizing detection options.

classes.name: VideoObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on videos and live streams, with support for different detection models and customizable detection and callback functions.
